meta.purpose: Deliberately broken. Every room here must be REJECTED, by the Python validator and by the C# loader. The spec (section 4) names the first two failure modes explicitly. Use it to prove the gate works: `python3 -m pipeline.cli validate configs/INVALID_do_not_ship.json` must exit non-zero.
